dev128 and screen1k, check and residual arms around the frozen recipe (tools/experiment_b2_det/arms3.py), none of them a candidate recipe: default_q_joins (the join exemption alone, which the first agent adopted together with the box exemption without a separate arm), default_fp32_box_logits and default_fp32_class_logits (the residual split by network output). Reason: on dev128 the arm cum5_fp32_box_logits is +0.56 [+0.21, +0.87] over its base, which meets the 0.5-point test of the freeze rule if the box logits are read as a head exemption; the first agent had classed the two logit exemptions as diagnostics before running them (handoff of 19:48) and the frozen recipe keeps both network outputs as k-bit codes. The frozen recipe is not changed; the document reports this reading and the measured size of the choice.
not_run_and_why: The registered arms around the bias-corrected ladder (full_* around cum8 and cum6_* around cum6, except cum6_bias_correction and cum6_fused_silu) were never run on any panel: their base is 11 to 16 points below its own leave-one-out arm on dev128, and addendum 1 moved the same questions to the base without bias correction (cum5_*) and, after the freeze, to the ablations of the frozen recipe (default_*). They are reported as not run.
exit_statement_rule: The exit statement reports the screen1k difference INT8 frozen recipe minus FP32 in mAP50-95 points with its paired 95 percent interval, says whether the point estimate is inside 1.0 point, and gives the residual account from the default_* diagnostics (weights only, activations only, FP32 head, FP32 input, head left as logits, leave-one-out) whatever the verdict. No arm is added to move the number.
sentinel_reporting: Each sentinel format is reported with the frozen recipe (default), with the frozen recipe whose head stores stop at the logits (default_head_logits, a registered ablation that the first agent queued for every format before any sentinel result existed) and with its sealed v1 max-abs and percentile results. The frozen recipe stays the headline; the head-logits column is reported because the head decision was taken on INT8 evidence only.
tie_reporting: For int8, int6, fp6_e2m3 and bfp6 under the frozen recipe: mAP under the fixed rule, under the reversed rule, under four random rules, and the true-positives-first / false-positives-first envelope at fixed image-local matching; the same envelope for the sealed v1 predictions. Unchanged from the protocol.
